connect.a: easyrender is an MCP server. Add it to Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP client with your API key, and your agent can turn photos into 3D models on its own. Everything it makes shows up in your web dashboard.

needAgent.q: Do I need an agent to use it?
needAgent.a: No. You can upload photos in the web app, one by one or in bulk from your library. The agent just lets you run it on autopilot.

photos.a: One sharp, well lit photo where the whole object is visible, ideally on a plain background. Catalogue shots and listing photos of a single piece or a building front work great.

scope.a: Furniture, decor objects and building exteriors. Whole interior rooms are not supported yet. Fine logos and small text come out soft.

output.a: A textured GLB for the web and a USDZ for iPhone Quick Look, plus a hosted 3D viewer you can share or embed on a listing.

freePreview.a: Before building the model we draw the object from every angle. You check that preview for free and only spend credits when it looks right.

failed.a: Failed renders are refunded to your balance automatically.

public.a: Finished models appear in the public gallery by default. You can hide any of yours from its page at any time.
